metadata.title: Extreme Close-Up Portrait with Vertical Industrial Typography

retrievalProfile.description: An extreme macro portrait cropped to one side of the face paired with vertical, industrial-styled slab serif typography separated by horizontal rules.
triggerTerms: vertical stacked text with horizontal lines
excludeWhen: minimalist clean sans-serif styles are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, warm-toned macro photograph of a smiling male face, cropped so the nose and one eye dominate the left two-thirds, while the right third features vertically oriented, industrial-themed text separated by thin horizontal dividers against a dark, out-of-focus background.
coreVisualRelationships: Macro skin texture vs. sharp geometric typography
Warm facial tones vs. cool gray industrial text
Asymmetrical facial crop vs. structured vertical text column
Soft bokeh background vs. crisp horizontal rule lines
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up cropping showing eye, nose, and mouth corner
Horizontal divider lines between text blocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is scaled to fill the frame, positioned off-center to the left, showing only the right half of the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp, blue eye in the upper left quadrant acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye leads down the bridge of the nose to the smile, then moves right to the vertically stacked text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, blurred negative space on the far right provides a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm flesh tones (peaches, tans, and browns) in the portrait.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal or black for the background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool gray and white for the typography and divider lines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the skin tones contrasted with desaturated, neutral tones in the graphic elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with industrial proportions
letterConstructionRules: Internal 'rivet' or 'perforated' texture within the letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are rotated 90 degrees clockwise to read vertically top-to-bottom
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two different sizes/weights separated by graphic lines.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal white rules extending from the text to the right edge

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab serif weight and geometric structure.
Captures the industrial, mechanical feel of the textured lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme macro portrait of a man's face, cropped to show only the right side (eye, nose, mouth) with high skin texture and warm lighting against a dark, blurry background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two columns of vertically stacked, 90-degree rotated uppercase slab-serif text on the right side. Place thin horizontal white lines between each letter of the primary name.

verificationChecks: Is the face cropped to show only one eye and half the nose?
Is the text rotated 90 degrees and stacked vertically?
Are there horizontal lines separating the letters?
Does the text have an industrial, textured appearance?

adjustableVariables: Width of the vertical text column
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist name or album title
Do not replicate the exact rivet pattern if it constitutes a unique brand mark

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the eye and skin pores
Balanced asymmetry between the face and the text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text rotation is exactly 90 degrees
Verify horizontal lines are perfectly parallel
Confirm the eye is the sharpest point of the image
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro Portrait + Vertical Industrial Slab Typography + Horizontal Rule Dividers
